name: feature-card
description: Feature card: icon + heading + description + link. Composition counterpart of the former panel/feature-card block — the docs knowledge-base cards were converted to this arrangement (live example).
provenPattern: Converted from a block to a composition under the rule 'arrangement-only → template'; the look was ported from the former block component.

knowledge.purpose: Feature card of icon, heading, description and link
useCases: A single cell of the feature grid
antiPatterns: Labelling the link with a word like "More" that does not say where it goes
Writing the description longer than two lines — the card falls out of alignment in the grid
Picking an icon outside the icon canon — it renders as an empty circle
